model: WTX water-cooled chiller with Turbocor compressors (pCO5+ BMS)
applies_to: Aermec WTX oil-free (Danfoss Turbocor) water-cooled chillers with the pCO5+ controller, via the AER485P1 RS485 card or AERNET; BMS manual for WTX 5009100_00 (1705).
summary: The WTX controller is a Carel pCO5+ that answers Modbus RTU through the AER485P1 card. This map lists the integer registers (chiller mode, compressor states, currents, voltages, demand and limits, run-hour counters, unit status) and the digital points (on/off, alarm reset, relay outputs and the full alarm list for up to four Turbocor compressors).

addressing.note: The manual states protocol addresses are base 0 and that addresses start from zero; its example reads address 1 with the frame 01 03 00 01. The BMS addresses in the tables go on the wire unchanged. Integer variables sit at 5001 + the Carel index (Carel 1 = 5002).

source.title: Manuale per creazione BMS - BMS manual, Connessione tramite Internet ModBus, WTX
source.pages: English section: p. 13 BMS card defaults, pp. 14-15 analogue variables (not mapped), pp. 15-16 integer variables, pp. 17-21 digital variables

notes: Left out: all analogue variables (temperatures, pressures, setpoints, addresses 1-205). The manual lists ranges like -999.9 to 999.9 but never states the register scale, so the raw-to-value factor is not settled.

Also left out: compressor speed, minimum and maximum speed registers (5006/5007, 5037-5040, 5104/5105, 5116-5119), because the '[0 ... 48000] / 10 RPM' wording does not make clear whether the register holds rpm or rpm/10; and 5003 (Aermec internal use).
Run-hour counters come in two parts: an upper register in thousands of hours and a lower register in hours (0-999).
Digital points are read with function 1 and written with function 5, so they are listed as coils; integer variables use functions 3 and 6.

integration.summary: Read coil 1 for unit on, coil 100 (sum of all alarms) and integer 5206 for unit status; write coil 10 to switch the plant from the BMS and coil 2 to reset alarms. Demand limit is integer 5012 (R/W).
integration.enable: Fit the AER485P1 card (RS485) or AERNET (Ethernet) in the pCO5+ BMS slot; BMS card defaults are 19200 baud, no parity, 2 stop bits.
quirks: Addresses are protocol (base 0) addresses; do not subtract 1.
Integers live at 5001 + Carel index; digitals and analogues use the plain index.
setup: Set the BMS address and serial settings on the pCO5+ to match the master (default 19200 baud, 8N2 as listed).
gotchas: Without a stated scale, verify any analogue value you add against the unit display before using it.
